{{Quote|We've been here for nearly one Standard month, and it's taken me most of that time to find windows of access into their systems, even though I'm rated as a contract computer tech supervisor first class.|Rekkon|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
A '''computer tech supervisor first class''' was a contract employee of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They would direct a team of [[Technician/Legends|computer techs]] in duties pertaining to data processing as well as information storage and retrieval. Tech supervisors were often contracted for [[Authority Data Center]]s.
